pairs: in remembrance that the Lord had saved him.
Confundantur, et revereantur, qui quærunt animam meam.
May those who seek my soul be confounded and awed.
May those who wish evils upon me be turned back and blush with shame.
May they be turned away immediately,
avertantur statim erubescentes qui dicunt mihi:
Exsultent et lætentur in te omnes qui quærunt te;
Let all who seek you exult
and let those who love your salvation forever say:
Ego vero egenus et pauper sum;
I am truly destitute and poor.
Adjutor meus et liberator meus es tu;
You are my helper and my deliverer.
